title: East Nashville- less than 2 miles from Broadway
description:
This clean and spacious 1930s craftsman is the perfect location to explore Nashville's most progressive neighborhood on foot.  Situated right around the corner from bustling 5 Points and only 2 miles to downtown, experience Music City like an Eastside local.

The space
-Fully stocked kitchen with everything you need to prepare a meal at home.
-A drip coffee and Keurig station to supply your coffee needs within seconds.
-2600 spacious square feet; including 5 beds and 2 couches.
-2 bathrooms with full showers, as well as a single bathroom with a claw foot tub for a restful soak.
-A true Southern covered front porch for a relaxed hang.

Guest access
There is a keypad on the front door that allows self check in. The access code will be provided the night before check in via Air BnB message.

Other things to note
Due to the coronavirus, I'm taking extra care to disinfect frequently touched surfaces between reservations, cleaning and disinfecting and following Air BnB's enhanced cleaning protocol.
I also have hand sanitizer in every room and at the front door as well.
Thank you for considering my Air Bnb.
